name: Pixel Symmetry
description: Detects unnatural 像素 symmetry patterns
algorithm: Pixel Symmetry — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes pixel-level symmetry for image forensic analysis:

1. **对称性检测**: Multiple types of pixel-level symmetry are detected — bilateral (mirror) symmetry, rotational symmetry, and translational symmetry (repetition). Symmetry is measured using normalized cross-correlation between the image region and its transformed version.

2. **Naturalvs.Artificial对称性**: Natural images contain approximate symmetry (faces, architecture, natural objects) but never perfect pixel-level symmetry due to noise, lighting variation, and 3D perspective. The method measures symmetry precision — AI-generated images may show unnaturally precise symmetry (too perfect for a camera capture) per the analysis of Corvi et al. (2023).

3. **局部对称性Maps**: A per-pixel or per-region symmetry score map is computed showing the degree and type of local symmetry. The spatial distribution of symmetry reveals structural properties. AI generators may produce symmetry artifacts — unexpected symmetry patterns from the generator's architecture (e.g., U-Net skip connections creating symmetric features).

4. **对称性Breaking分析**: In natural images, physical factors break perfect symmetry — shadows, specularity, perspective foreshortening. The method checks whether expected symmetry-breaking factors are present. AI-generated images might maintain symmetry where physical factors should break it.

5. **对称性Feature评分**: Symmetry features (precision, spatial distribution, type frequency, symmetry-breaking correspondence) are combined into a forensic score. The score measures how well the image's symmetry properties match expectations for natural photography versus AI generation.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 图像
输入: 原始像素数据 / 图像文件
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
处理方式: 客户端 Canvas API
色彩空间: RGB、灰度（视情况而定）
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-90% 独立准确率. 在未压缩图像上性能最佳 and 在重度JPEG压缩或社交媒体重新编码时可能降低.
source: 数字图像取证研究。基于信号处理和计算摄影原理.
useCase: 通过以下方式检测AI生成或篡改的图像： 像素 symmetry 分析。该方法识别AI生成特有的模式和伪影，为全面的图像取证分析做出贡献.
strengths:
• 使用 Canvas API 快速客户端处理
• 有效检测特定的AI生成伪影
• 支持常见图像格式（JPEG、PNG、WebP）
• 可与互补的分析方法组合使用
• 基于成熟的图像取证研究
limitations:
• 性能可能因图像压缩级别而异
• 社交媒体重新编码可能影响准确性
• 最好与其他取证方法结合使用
• 对经过大量处理的真实图像可能产生误报
• 有效性取决于所使用的AI生成模型

references.title: Corvi et al. (2023). On the Detection of Synthetic Images Generated by Diffusion Models. ICASSP.
Wang, S.Y. et al. (2020). CNN-generated images are surprisingly easy to spot. CVPR.
